description: Check if job postings are still open, with posted date and age in days

tool_signatures.name: check_job_posting_liveness
tool_signatures.description: Give job posting URLs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, or SmartRecruiters. Returns one row per URL: live or closed, job title, company, location, posted date, age in days, and when a run on your account last saw it live. Reads each ATS

job_urls.description: Posting URLs from Greenhouse (boards.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, or a company site with ?gh_jid=), Lever (jobs.lever.co), Ashby (jobs.ashbyhq.com), Workday (*.myworkdayjobs.com), or SmartRecruiters (jobs.smartrecruiters.com). Up to 5,000 per run. From Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Rows already checked are returned.
